title.zh: 卷二十 志第十 樂二
title.raw: 卷二十 志第十 樂二 Volume 20 Treatises 10: Music 2

translations.literal: Treatise Ten: Music Two
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Ten: Music II

sentences.zh: 蔡邕論敘漢樂曰：一曰郊廟神靈，二曰天子享宴，三曰大射辟雍，四曰短簫鐃歌。

translations.literal: Cai Yong's treatise on Han music states: first, suburban and temple spirits; second, the Son of Heaven's feasts and banquets; third, the great archery at the Bright Hall; fourth, short-pipe and beat-gong songs.
translations.idiomatic: In his discussion of Han music, Cai Yong classified it into four types: music for suburban and temple spirits, music for imperial feasts, music for the great archery ceremony at the Bright Hall, and short-pipe and beat-gong songs.

sentences.zh: 晉郊祀歌五篇 傅玄造

translations.literal: Five Jin suburban sacrifice songs, composed by Fu Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Five Songs for Jin Suburban Sacrifices, by Fu Xuan

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate rests upon Jin; solemn and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has given its mandate to Jin—solemn, august, and bright.

translations.literal: We rise early and stay late, reverently serving the supreme spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night we devote ourselves, reverently serving the spirits on high.

translations.literal: Always at the proper season we pause, and thus accomplish our ends.
translations.idiomatic: We perform the rites in their proper seasons, until all is brought to completion.

translations.literal: In offering the black bull, we present the evening sacrifice and its victims.
translations.idiomatic: We offer the dark bull of sacrifice and present the evening victims.

translations.literal: We exalt virtue and create music; the spirits listen.
translations.idiomatic: We honor virtue in our music, and the gods attend.

sentences.zh: 右祠天地五郊夕牲歌一篇。

translations.literal: Right: one song for evening victims at the suburban sacrifices to Heaven and Earth at the five suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: [Above:] One song for presenting the evening sacrifice at the five suburban altars to Heaven and Earth.

translations.literal: The propagating culture is abundant; it is said to bring peace to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Our culture spreads far and wide, bringing peace to every quarter of the realm.

translations.literal: Forever we speak of preserving it; early and late we find no rest.
translations.idiomatic: We ever pledge to uphold it, toiling day and night without ease.

translations.literal: We glorify Heaven's mandate; the Supreme Lord we revere.
translations.idiomatic: We glorify Heaven's mandate and revere the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Fine music is richly offered; the spirits' blessing shines forth auspiciously.
translations.idiomatic: With splendid music we make our offerings, and the spirits' blessing shines bright.

translations.literal: The spirits descend in abundance; we enjoy blessings without bound.
translations.idiomatic: The gods descend in grace, and blessings without end are ours.

sentences.zh: 右祠天地五郊迎送神歌一篇。

translations.literal: Right: one song for welcoming and escorting the spirits at the suburban sacrifices to Heaven and Earth at the five suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: [Above:] One song for welcoming and escorting the spirits at the five suburban altars to Heaven and Earth.

translations.literal: Heaven's blessing rests upon Jin; its mandate is ever renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's favor rests on Jin, whose mandate is ever renewed.

translations.literal: Receiving the end from Wei, we embrace the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the mandate from Wei, we hold sway over all the people.

translations.literal: We feast and reach to August Heaven; we cherish and soothe the hundred spirits.
translations.idiomatic: We feast and reach to August Heaven, cherishing and soothing the hundred spirits.

translations.literal: The illustrious legacy left behind—its virtue is pure.
translations.idiomatic: The illustrious legacy of our forebears—how pure their virtue.

translations.literal: We offer the black bull; thus we begin the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: We offer the dark bull and thus inaugurate the suburban rite.

translations.literal: The spirits come to attend; blessings and emoluments arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits come to attend, and blessings and prosperity arrive.

translations.literal: The seasons advance like a journey; August Heaven is our lord.
translations.idiomatic: The seasons march onward; August Heaven is our sovereign.

translations.literal: Blessed and possessing Jin, the myriad people bear it on their heads.
translations.idiomatic: Blessed with Jin, the myriad people uphold it.

translations.literal: We fear Heaven's majesty and reverently bestow the seasons upon the people.
translations.idiomatic: We fear Heaven's majesty and reverently teach the people the seasons.

translations.literal: Not illustrious, not continuing—yet in this we still ponder deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Though we cannot match their glory, still we ponder their legacy with care.

translations.literal: The supreme pole is thus established; all achievements shine forth.
translations.idiomatic: The supreme pole is established, and every achievement flourishes.

translations.literal: We hope early and late; this is Jin's good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night we strive—such is Jin's blessing.

translations.literal: The propagating culture is our sovereign; able to match that Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Our sovereign of propagating culture is fit to match Heaven on high.

translations.literal: Pacifying and settling the four seas, we preserve the years of peace.
translations.idiomatic: He pacifies the four seas and preserves the years of peace.

translations.literal: Ah, we gather brightness; thus we bring peace to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, how bright his radiance—by it he brings peace to the people.

translations.literal: Thereupon we establish musical regulations; thereupon we repair ritual statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He established musical regulations and restored ritual statutes.

translations.literal: Making the people's standard—nothing is not founded upon this.
translations.idiomatic: He set the standard for the people; all things begin from this.

translations.literal: Able to flourish his descendants; forever we speak of preserving it.
translations.idiomatic: May his descendants flourish; forever we pledge to uphold it.

translations.literal: Right: three songs for feasting Heaven and Earth at the five suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: [Above:] Three songs for the feast-sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the five suburban altars.

sentences.zh: 前所作天地郊明堂歌五篇 傅玄造

translations.literal: Five songs previously composed for Heaven and Earth suburban sacrifice and Bright Hall, by Fu Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Five Songs for Suburban Sacrifice to Heaven and Earth and the Bright Hall, by Fu Xuan

translations.literal: Sublime is Jin; the seasons advance its virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Sublime is Jin, whose virtue advances with the seasons.

translations.literal: Receiving the end from Heaven, its light succors the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the mandate from Heaven, its radiance succors every state.

translations.literal: The myriad states having been illumined, the spirits fix their auspice.
translations.idiomatic: When every state is illumined, the spirits confirm their blessing.

translations.literal: Reverent at the suburban sacrifice, we reverently serve the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent at the suburban rite, we devoutly serve the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Reverently serving the Supreme Lord, the hundred blessings arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Devoutly serving the Supreme Lord, the hundred blessings arrive.

translations.literal: Lofty are our ancestors; able to match that Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty are our forebears, fit to match Heaven on high.

translations.literal: Fine victims are not what delight them; virtue's fragrance alone is feasted.
translations.idiomatic: Fine victims do not delight them—only the fragrance of virtue is feasted.

translations.literal: Receiving Heaven's blessing, the spirits harmonize and the four quarters flow freely.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving Heaven's blessing, the spirits harmonize and the four quarters flourish.

translations.literal: Right: the song for evening victims at the suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth and the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: [Above:] Song for presenting the evening sacrifice at the suburban altars to Heaven and Earth and the Bright Hall.

translations.literal: Sublime is great Jin; it receives Heaven's glorious auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Sublime is great Jin, which receives Heaven's glorious blessing.

translations.literal: The two emperors advanced in virtue; they spread this redoubled radiance.
translations.idiomatic: The two emperors advanced in virtue and spread this redoubled radiance.

translations.literal: Our emperor received the mandate; he embraces the myriad regions.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor received the mandate and holds sway over every region.

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice we offer paired feasts; ritual and music are greatly manifest.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice we offer paired feasts; ritual and music are fully displayed.

translations.literal: The spirits delight in the feast; our ancestors we revere.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits delight in the feast, and our ancestors we revere.

translations.literal: Able to flourish his descendants; we preserve the blessing without bound.
translations.idiomatic: May his descendants flourish; may the blessing be preserved without end.

translations.literal: Right: the song for descending spirits at the suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth and the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: [Above:] Song for the descent of the spirits at the suburban altars to Heaven and Earth and the Bright Hall.

translations.literal: We arrange the great altar and sacrifice to the august spirits.
translations.idiomatic: We prepare the great altar and sacrifice to the august spirits.

translations.literal: Essence and breath are stirred; the hundred spirits come as guests.
translations.idiomatic: Essence and breath are stirred, and the hundred spirits gather as guests.

translations.literal: We bank the vermilion fire and blaze fragrant fuel.
translations.idiomatic: We bank the vermilion fire and blaze fragrant kindling.

translations.literal: Purple smoke drifts, crowning the azure clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Purple smoke drifts upward, crowning the azure clouds.

translations.literal: The spirits' substance has no likeness or form.
translations.idiomatic: The substance of the spirits has no likeness or form.

translations.literal: Vast without direction, dark yet pure.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and boundless, dark yet pure.

translations.literal: When the spirits come, light and radiance shine.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits come, light and radiance shine forth.

translations.literal: In hearing, nothing is heard; in seeing, no sign appears.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing is heard though we listen; no sign appears though we look.

translations.literal: When the spirits arrive, all rejoice with gladness.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits arrive, all rejoice with gladness.

translations.literal: The spirits' presence harmonizes; it moves our hearts.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits' presence harmonizes and moves our hearts.

translations.literal: When the spirits are seated, all share in joy and delight.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits are seated, all share in joy and delight.

translations.literal: Moistening clouds soar; the transforming wind spreads.
translations.idiomatic: Moistening clouds soar aloft; the transforming wind spreads abroad.

translations.literal: Fine music is played; cultured sounds within.
translations.idiomatic: Fine music is played, its cultured tones resounding.

translations.literal: The eight sounds harmonize; the spirits listen.
translations.idiomatic: The eight sounds harmonize, and the spirits listen.

translations.literal: All are purified and arrayed; together fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: All offerings are purified and arrayed, together fragrant.

translations.literal: We cook the sacrificial beasts and offer jade goblets.
translations.idiomatic: We cook the sacrificial beasts and offer jade goblets.

translations.literal: The spirits are pleased and feast; they delight in the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are pleased and feast, delighting in the suburban sacrifice.

translations.literal: They bless great Jin and send down abundant blessings.
translations.idiomatic: They bless great Jin and send down abundant blessings.

translations.literal: The sacrificial flesh reaches the capital; it extends through the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial flesh reaches the capital and extends through the four seas.

translations.literal: We preserve Heaven's years and exhaust the earth's chronicle.
translations.idiomatic: We preserve Heaven's years to the end of the earth's chronicle.

translations.literal: Right: the song for feasting the spirits at the suburban sacrifice to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: [Above:] Song for feasting the spirits at the suburban altar to Heaven.

translations.literal: We arrange the great procession and await the august spirits.
translations.idiomatic: We arrange the great procession and await the august spirits.

translations.literal: The multitude of spirits are stirred; the host of numina take their places.
translations.idiomatic: The multitude of spirits are stirred, and the host of numina take their places.

translations.literal: The yin sacrifice is set forth; auspicious rites are performed.
translations.idiomatic: The yin sacrifice is set forth and auspicious rites are performed.

translations.literal: Night is nearing its depth; the hour has not yet shifted.
translations.idiomatic: Night is nearing its depth, yet the hour has not yet shifted.

translations.literal: The spirits' substance has no likeness or form.
translations.idiomatic: The substance of the spirits has no likeness or form.

translations.literal: Hidden in the great dark, penetrating the sudden void.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden in the great dark, penetrating the sudden void.

translations.literal: When the spirits emerge, dimly as if present.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits emerge, dimly as if present.

translations.literal: The spirits are not far; they are mother to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are never far—they are mother to all under Heaven.

translations.literal: When the spirits come, they leave behind light and radiance.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits come, they leave behind light and radiance.

translations.literal: Shining as if present, yet in the end dark and obscure.
translations.idiomatic: Shining as if present, yet in the end dark and obscure.

translations.literal: When the spirits arrive, all rejoice with gladness.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits arrive, all rejoice with gladness.

translations.literal: We dance the image of virtue; we sing the completed pattern.
translations.idiomatic: We dance the image of virtue and sing the completed pattern.

translations.literal: When the spirits are seated, all share in joy and ease.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits are seated, all share in joy and ease.

translations.literal: Moistening rain is bestowed; transforming clouds spread.
translations.idiomatic: Moistening rain is bestowed and transforming clouds spread abroad.

translations.literal: Music undergoes eight transformations; sound and teaching spread.
translations.idiomatic: Music undergoes eight transformations, and sound and teaching spread abroad.

translations.literal: All things equally feast; the spirits are thus delighted.
translations.idiomatic: All things equally feast, and the spirits are thus delighted.

translations.literal: The fast having been purified, the attendants are solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The fast having been purified, the attendants stand solemn.

translations.literal: Jade goblets are presented; all are solemn and grave.
translations.idiomatic: Jade goblets are presented; all stand solemn and grave.

translations.literal: We feast in fine celebration; we delight in virtue's fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: We feast in fine celebration, delighting in virtue's fragrance.

translations.literal: The sacrificial flesh reaches Jin and extends to all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial flesh reaches Jin and extends to all living beings.

translations.literal: It overflows the nine regions and reaches the celestial court.
translations.idiomatic: It overflows the nine regions and reaches the celestial court.

translations.literal: We preserve ten thousand years and extend a hundred million ages.
translations.idiomatic: We preserve ten thousand years and extend a hundred million ages.

translations.literal: Right: the song for feasting the spirits at the suburban sacrifice to Earth.
translations.idiomatic: [Above:] Song for feasting the spirits at the suburban altar to Earth.

translations.literal: We began and completed the Bright Hall; in feasting and sacrifice we are not remiss.
translations.idiomatic: We founded the Bright Hall and never slackened in our feasts and sacrifices.

translations.literal: Ah, our illustrious forefather; his glory matches the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, our illustrious forefather, whose glory matches the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Sublime is the Supreme Lord, both lofty and exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Sublime is the Supreme Lord, lofty and exalted.

translations.literal: Our sage forefather is matched to Him; bright virtue shines and blends.
translations.idiomatic: Our sage forefather is matched to Him; bright virtue shines and blends.

translations.literal: Throughout the land all reverently perform their duties; the myriad regions come to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the land all reverently perform their duties, and the myriad regions come to sacrifice.

translations.literal: Always at the proper season we pause; we preserve the sacrificial flesh for eternal ages.
translations.idiomatic: We perform the rites in their proper seasons and preserve the sacrificial blessing for all time.

translations.literal: Right: the song for feasting the spirits at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Song for feasting the spirits at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 宋南郊雅樂登歌三篇 顏延之造

translations.literal: Three Song southern suburban elegant music ascending songs, composed by Yan Yanzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Three Ascending Songs for Song Southern Suburban Elegant Music, by Yan Yanzhi

translations.literal: We revere the august mandate, the precious command; solemn and reverent toward the imperial ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: We revere the august mandate and honor the imperial ancestors with solemn reverence.

translations.literal: Manifesting over the sea, blazing on Mount Tai; linked to Tang, descended from Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Our glory spans the sea and blazes on Mount Tai; our line descends from Tang and Chu.

translations.literal: The spirits discern our deep culture; the people attach themselves to sagely martial virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits discern our deep culture; the people rally to our sagely martial virtue.

translations.literal: We suddenly receive the broad bestowal; dwelling at the center, we expand our domain.
translations.idiomatic: We receive the broad bestowal of Heaven, dwelling at the center and expanding our domain.

translations.literal: Spanning the earth we are called emperor; exhausting Heaven we become its lord.
translations.idiomatic: We span the earth as emperor and exhaust Heaven as its sovereign.

translations.literal: From the moon's corner they come as guests; from the sun's verge they present their soil.
translations.idiomatic: From the farthest corners they come as guests; from the sun's verge they present their tribute.

translations.literal: At the founding year, the first month; ritual is exchanged and music raised.
translations.idiomatic: In the founding year, at the first month, ritual is exchanged and music is raised.

translations.literal: Six melodies link the affairs; nine officers array in order.
translations.idiomatic: Six melodies link the affairs; nine officers array in order.

translations.literal: There are pure victims in the washing pen; there are cleansed offerings on the stands.
translations.idiomatic: Pure victims stand in the washing pen; cleansed offerings rest on the stands.

translations.literal: With the offered pig we express the king's innermost heart; with it we answer the spirits' blessing.
translations.idiomatic: With the offered pig we express the king's innermost heart and answer the spirits' blessing.

translations.literal: Right: the song for evening victims at the suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Song for presenting the evening sacrifice at the suburban altars to Heaven and Earth.

translations.literal: Only the sage feasts the Lord; only the filial feasts his kin.
translations.idiomatic: Only the sage feasts the Lord; only the filial feasts his kin.

translations.literal: Sublime! All is prepared; we have affairs in the upper spring.
translations.idiomatic: Sublime! All is prepared for the spring rites on high.

translations.literal: Ritual proceeds at the ancestral sacrifice; reverence reaches the suburban offering.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual proceeds at the ancestral sacrifice; reverence reaches the suburban offering.

translations.literal: Golden branches planted at the center; broad music arrayed on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Golden branches are planted at the center; broad music is arrayed on four sides.

translations.literal: Ascending, we are matched in the capital; descending, virtue rests upon the people.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending, we are matched in the capital; descending, virtue rests upon the people.

translations.literal: Rushing essence illumines the night; high blazing fires light the dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Rushing essence illumines the night; high blazing fires light the dawn.

translations.literal: Yin brightness floats and glitters; submerged offerings sink deep.
translations.idiomatic: Yin brightness floats and glitters; submerged offerings sink into the deep.

translations.literal: We announce the great completion and great return; we receive blessing from the primal spirit.
translations.idiomatic: We announce the great completion and great return; we receive blessing from the primal spirit.

translations.literal: The moon's charioteer holds to the measure; star drivers support the wheel.
translations.idiomatic: The moon's charioteer holds to the measure; star drivers support the wheel.

translations.literal: From afar they rise, from far they drive; blazing bright, vigorous and strong.
translations.idiomatic: From afar they rise and drive; blazing bright, vigorous and strong.

translations.literal: Right: the song for welcoming and escorting the spirits at the suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Song for welcoming and escorting the spirits at the suburban altars to Heaven and Earth.

translations.literal: We lay out the great altar and fix Heaven's innermost heart.
translations.idiomatic: We lay out the great altar and fix Heaven's innermost purpose.

translations.literal: Our thoughts are sagely; divination and planning accord.
translations.idiomatic: Our thoughts are sagely; divination and planning accord.

translations.literal: We erect the marker and reed-mat; we establish the suburban palace.
translations.idiomatic: We erect the marker and reed-mat and establish the suburban palace.

translations.literal: Field candles are set; torch fires connect.
translations.idiomatic: Field candles are set; torch fires connect in a chain.

translations.literal: Passing through the year's first ten-day period; the pitch-pipe's head is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through the year's first ten-day period, the pitch-pipe's head is auspicious.

translations.literal: We adorn the purple altar; in the pit we array the chambers.
translations.idiomatic: We adorn the purple altar; in the pit we array the chambers.

translations.literal: The central stars give their sign; the six ancestors are ranked in order.
translations.idiomatic: The central stars give their sign; the six ancestors are ranked in order.

translations.literal: Heaven's realm is tranquil; the earth's regions are still.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's realm is tranquil; the earth's regions are still.

translations.literal: Great filial piety shines forth; sacrificial ritual is offered.
translations.idiomatic: Great filial piety shines forth; sacrificial ritual is offered.

translations.literal: On the victim day we display them; the abundance comes from our own person.
translations.idiomatic: On the victim day we display them; the abundance comes from our own person.

translations.literal: Vessels are fully arrayed; ritual bearing is prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels are fully arrayed; ritual bearing is prepared.

translations.literal: Form-dances are linked; covered by song and bells.
translations.idiomatic: Form-dances are linked; covered by song and bells.

translations.literal: We gaze toward the Lord's gate; the spirits' procession rises high.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze toward the Lord's gate; the spirits' procession rises high.

translations.literal: When the spirits come, the morning light overflows.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits come, the morning light overflows.

translations.literal: Pure grain is poured; we delight the Great Unity.
translations.idiomatic: Pure grain is poured; we delight the Great Unity.

translations.literal: Bright radiance in the night; splendid clarity in the day.
translations.idiomatic: Bright radiance in the night; splendid clarity in the day.

translations.literal: The unhusked grain having begun, the offering again concludes.
translations.idiomatic: The unhusked grain having begun, the offering again concludes.

translations.literal: Smoke and fragrant libation; we report to the clear vault.
translations.idiomatic: Smoke and fragrant libation rise; we report to the clear vault.

translations.literal: We feast Song's virtue; the sacrificial flesh rewards the king's merit.
translations.idiomatic: We feast Song's virtue; the sacrificial flesh rewards the king's merit.

translations.literal: The mandate of rest is eternal; blessings and good fortune are full.
translations.idiomatic: The mandate of rest is eternal; blessings and good fortune are full.

translations.literal: Right: the song for feasting the spirits at Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Song for feasting the spirits at Heaven and Earth.

translations.literal: Song Bright Hall songs, composed by Xie Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Song Bright Hall Songs, by Xie Zhuang

translations.literal: Earth's pivot is tranquil; Heaven's hub turns.
translations.idiomatic: Earth's pivot is tranquil; Heaven's hub turns.

translations.literal: The canopy of stars moves; Purple Subtlety opens.
translations.idiomatic: The canopy of stars moves; Purple Subtlety opens.

translations.literal: Banners blot out the sun; chariots like clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Banners blot out the sun; chariots crowd like clouds.

translations.literal: We drive the six breaths; we mount the swirling mist.
translations.idiomatic: We drive the six breaths and mount the swirling mist.

translations.literal: The imperial capital blazes bright; the celestial city gleams.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial capital blazes bright; the celestial city gleams.

translations.literal: The sage ancestor descends; the five numina gather.
translations.idiomatic: The sage ancestor descends; the five numina gather.

translations.literal: We construct jade steps; pearl curtains rise high.
translations.idiomatic: We construct jade steps; pearl curtains rise high.

translations.literal: The Milky Way brushes the curtains; the moon perches on the eaves.
translations.idiomatic: The Milky Way brushes the curtains; the moon perches on the eaves.

translations.literal: Dance sequences are arranged; bells and stones blend.
translations.idiomatic: Dance sequences are arranged; bells and stones blend in harmony.

translations.literal: Flying radiance halts; dense winds of procession arise.
translations.idiomatic: Flying radiance halts; dense winds of procession arise.

translations.literal: We strive in grain offerings; we purify sacrificial beasts.
translations.idiomatic: We strive in grain offerings; we purify sacrificial beasts.

translations.literal: The hundred rites are solemn; the host of officers are reverent.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred rites are solemn; the host of officers are reverent.

translations.literal: Imperial virtue reaches far; great filial piety flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial virtue reaches far; great filial piety flourishes.

translations.literal: Piercing the nine dark regions; penetrating the three luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: Piercing the nine dark regions; penetrating the three luminaries.

translations.literal: When the spirits are at rest, the jade chariot-bells are unfastened.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits are at rest, the jade chariot-bells are unfastened.

translations.literal: Bright blessings arrive; the myriad realms rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Bright blessings arrive; the myriad realms rejoice.

translations.literal: Right: the hymn for welcoming the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Hymn for welcoming the spirits

sentences.zh: 〈依漢郊祀迎神，三言，四句一轉韻。〉

translations.literal: Following the Han suburban sacrifice song for welcoming spirits: three-character lines, rhyme changing every four lines.
translations.idiomatic: Modeled on the Han suburban sacrifice song for welcoming spirits: three-character lines, rhyme changing every four lines.

translations.literal: At Yong Terrace we distinguish the new moon; at Marsh Palace we select the auspicious day.
translations.idiomatic: At Yong Terrace we distinguish the new moon; at Marsh Palace we select the auspicious day.

translations.literal: Purified fire illumines the evening; bright water is displayed at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Purified fire illumines the evening; bright water is displayed at dawn.

translations.literal: Six hu vessels adorn the chamber; eight feathered dancers grace the court.
translations.idiomatic: Six hu vessels adorn the chamber; eight feathered dancers grace the court.

translations.literal: We make manifest service to the former sages; we cherish and moisten the spirits on high.
translations.idiomatic: We honor the former sages and cherish the spirits on high.

translations.literal: Si Xia warns of reverence; the ascending song releases virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Si Xia warns of reverence; the ascending song releases virtue.

translations.literal: Forever firm the great foundation; thereby we pacify the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Forever firm the great foundation; thereby we pacify the myriad states.

translations.literal: Right: the ascending song text.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending song text

translations.literal: Formerly in four-character lines.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly in four-character lines.

translations.literal: Only Heaven is great; only the sage ancestor is our model.
translations.idiomatic: Only Heaven is great; only the sage ancestor is our model.

translations.literal: The celestial dwelling spans the myriad realms; suspended tassels reach the states below.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial dwelling spans the myriad realms; suspended tassels reach the states below.

translations.literal: Within, the eight assistants of the spirits; without, radiance on the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Within, the eight assistants of the spirits; without, radiance on the four seas.

translations.literal: The artemisia palace looks up to the canopy; the sun lodge rarely displays its banner.

translations.literal: Following the seasons, transforming; the myriad things then were formed.
translations.idiomatic: All things change with the seasons and thereby come into being.

translations.literal: The sage sovereign succeeded Heaven; his light aided all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: The sage emperor succeeds Heaven; his radiance succors every creature.

translations.literal: Transforming them with the Way; ten thousand states all at peace.
translations.idiomatic: He transforms the realm through the Way; ten thousand kingdoms are at peace.

translations.literal: Receiving this great blessing, extending to a hundred million ages.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving this great blessing, it endures for a hundred million years.

sentences.zh: 晉宗廟歌十一篇 傅玄造

translations.literal: Jin Ancestral Temple Songs, eleven pieces; composed by Fu Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven Jin Ancestral Temple Songs, composed by Fu Xuan.

translations.literal: Our evening, our sacrifice beast—ah, how reverent we halt!
translations.idiomatic: This evening, this victim—ah, how reverently we pause!

translations.literal: Fine fatted livestock most timely, offered for this enjoying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Fine fattened beasts, offered at the proper hour for this sacrificial feast.

translations.literal: The spirits discerned that sincerity; the broad and ample they rejoiced in.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits saw that sincerity and delighted in the rich offerings.

sentences.zh: 神考降饗，以虞孝孫之心。

translations.literal: The spirit-fathers descended to feast, to comfort the filial grandson's heart.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral spirits came down to feast and ease the filial grandson's heart.

translations.literal: Above: Ancestral temple song for presenting the evening sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Song for presenting the evening sacrifice at the ancestral temple.

translations.literal: Alas, how far-reaching!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, how vast and far-reaching!

translations.literal: The sun's mirror is here.
translations.idiomatic: The sun's bright mirror is here.

translations.literal: At the proper season, enjoying sacrifice—the spirits and bright ones descend.
translations.idiomatic: At the appointed season we offer sacrifice, and the spirits descend.

translations.literal: The spirits and bright ones thus descended, already blessing the feast.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits have descended and already bless this feast.

translations.literal: Bless our boundlessness; receive Heaven's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us boundless fortune; bestow Heaven's blessing.

translations.literal: Illustrious Supreme Lord, lofty sage ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious Supreme Ancestor, towering sage forebear.

translations.literal: Bright bright blazing father, greatly inheriting the successive order.
translations.idiomatic: Radiant glorious father, who grandly continued the line of succession.

translations.literal: Above: Ancestral temple song for welcoming and escorting the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Song for welcoming and escorting the spirits at the ancestral temple.

translations.literal: Beginning the ancestral temple, the spirits and bright ones arrived and halted.
translations.idiomatic: When the ancestral temple was first founded, the spirits came and rested there.

translations.literal: Repeatedly bestowing boundlessness, reverently undertaking the enjoying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He bestows boundless grace; we reverently perform the sacrificial feast.

translations.literal: How vast the imperial ancestor, bringing peace to grandsons and sons!
translations.idiomatic: How great the imperial ancestor, who brings peace to sons and grandsons!

translations.literal: Extending ease to posterity, granting this abundant felicity.
translations.idiomatic: He extends his favor to later generations and grants this abundant blessing.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the General Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the General Who Conquers the West.

translations.literal: Fine music spread in the courtyard; offerings presented in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Fine music fills the courtyard; offerings are set forth in the hall.

translations.literal: Majestic majestic ancestral temple—there are the ancestors, the emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn, glorious ancestral temple—home of our imperial forebears.

translations.literal: Numerous numerous feudal lords, assisting me in the seasonal sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Hosts of feudal lords assist me in the seasonal offering.

translations.literal: The enjoying sacrifice without error; blessings descend in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice is performed without fault; blessings pour down in plenty.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of Yuzhang.

translations.literal: How remote the Former and Latter—truly they oversee in Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: How distant our forebears and ancestress—they truly govern in Heaven.

translations.literal: Manifest is the imperial ancestor; the Emperor's blessing first arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious is the imperial ancestor; Heaven's blessing first came to him.

translations.literal: Root and branches able to flourish, supplying the beginning of the primal origin.
translations.idiomatic: Root and branches flourish together, founding the opening of the primal age.

translations.literal: Favoring us without bound; enjoying sacrifice through eternal years.
translations.idiomatic: He favors us without end; may sacrifice endure for ten thousand years.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of Yingchuan.

translations.literal: Ah, the former sovereign—bright bright excellent virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, the former emperor—his bright and splendid virtue shines forth.

translations.literal: Lofty and bright, clear and luminous; not contending, yet gently overcoming.
translations.idiomatic: High, clear, and luminous; he does not strive, yet gently prevails.

translations.literal: Preserving governance, commanding blessing; founding the mandate as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: He preserves the realm and commands blessing; he founded the mandate as the model.

translations.literal: Sincerely giving birth to the sage ancestor; his light aiding the four realms.
translations.idiomatic: He truly begot the sage ancestor, whose radiance succored the four quarters.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of Jingzhao.

translations.literal: How radiant the imperial ancestor—sage virtue revered and bright.
translations.idiomatic: How brilliant the imperial ancestor—sage virtue worthy and bright.

translations.literal: Diligently extending to the four directions, morning and evening reverent halt.
translations.idiomatic: He labors for the four quarters, reverent from dawn till dusk.

translations.literal: Then spreading civil teachings, then displaying martial prowess.
translations.idiomatic: He spreads civil culture and displays martial might.

translations.literal: Rectifying and settling the altars of soil and grain, reverently executing Heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He secured the altars of state and reverently carried out Heaven's punishment.

translations.literal: Beginning the great enterprise, founding and creating the imperial foundation.
translations.idiomatic: He began the great enterprise and founded the imperial throne.

translations.literal: In awe of Heaven's mandate, in that season preserving it.
translations.idiomatic: In awe of Heaven's mandate, he guarded it in his time.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to Emperor Xuan.

translations.literal: Striving in emulation, Emperor Jing—able to illumine, able to be wise.
translations.idiomatic: Striving and resolute, Emperor Jing was bright of insight and wise.

translations.literal: Broadly acting with solemn grace, only reverent, only in awe.
translations.idiomatic: His deeds were vast and solemn; he was reverent and full of awe.

translations.literal: Continuing the thread of Xuan, completing his achievements in old age.
translations.idiomatic: He continued Emperor Xuan's work and in his later years settled the achievement.

translations.literal: Ascending these outstanding worthy ones, correcting those multitudinous villains.
translations.idiomatic: He raised the outstanding and righted the hosts of villains.

translations.literal: Diligent diligent in position—the Emperor already ceased his labors.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent in his post, the Emperor had already rested from toil.

translations.literal: It is Heaven's mandate—how solemn, never ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Such is Heaven's mandate—how solemn and unending!

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to Emperor Jing.

translations.literal: How august timely Jin—the truly civil Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: How glorious is timely Jin—the truly cultured Emperor Wen.

translations.literal: Keen of hearing, bright of sight, wise and perceptive; sage reverence, spirit-like martial prowess.
translations.idiomatic: Keen, wise, and perceptive; in sage reverence and godlike martial power.

translations.literal: Myriad affairs none could gather—the Emperor then cleared them.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand affairs none could master—the Emperor brought them all to order.

translations.literal: Tigers and rhinos released their mandate—the Emperor then pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce beasts ran wild—the Emperor subdued them.

translations.literal: Gentle to the distant, able toward the near; selecting and appointing heroic worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Gentle to the far, capable with the near; he chose and appointed heroic men.

translations.literal: Founding the enterprise, handing down the succession; merit reaching to August Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the enterprise and handed down the succession; his merit reached August Heaven.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to Emperor Wen.

translations.literal: The Jin rite is the constant; enjoying sacrifice follows the seasonal order.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the Jin custom: sacrifice follows the seasons in their order.

translations.literal: The ancestral temple pays reverence; rites and music all raised up.
translations.idiomatic: We pay reverence at the ancestral temple; rites and music are fully performed.

translations.literal: When they come to sacrifice—all under Heaven within the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: When sacrifice is offered, all within Heaven and Earth gather.

translations.literal: The sacrificial goblet already set out; clear wine already presented.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial goblet is set forth; clear wine is presented.

translations.literal: Also there is harmonized broth; offerings of delicacies now complete.
translations.idiomatic: There is also harmonized broth; every delicacy is prepared.

translations.literal: Rising rising, ever yearning; moved by the season, thoughts arise.
translations.idiomatic: Ever rising in longing, moved by the season, our thoughts awaken.

translations.literal: Ascending songs performed, dances presented—the spirits delight in the harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending songs are sung and dances performed—the spirits delight in the harmony.

translations.literal: Ancestors and fathers come to arrive; bless our state and clans.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors come to attend and bless our kingdom and house.

translations.literal: Spreading under Heaven—none not resting in excellence.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the realm beneath Heaven, all share in blessing.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn in their places; numerous numerous ministers and craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn in their places stand the hosts of ministers and officers.

translations.literal: The four seas come to arrive; ritual and decorum have their proper form.
translations.idiomatic: From the four seas they come; ritual and decorum are properly observed.

translations.literal: Bells and drums shaken; pipes and strings ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums resound; pipes and strings are tuned.

translations.literal: Dancing "Opening the Origin"; singing "Eternal Beginning."
translations.idiomatic: They dance "Opening the Origin" and sing "Eternal Beginning."

translations.literal: The spirits all rejoice, ah!
translations.idiomatic: The spirits all rejoice!

translations.literal: Solemn solemn in their places; ministers and craftsmen numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn in their places; ministers and officers stand in ranks.

translations.literal: Small and great all reverent; above and below have ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Small and great alike are reverent; above and below observe ritual.

translations.literal: Ordering pipes and strings; shaking drums and bells.
translations.idiomatic: Pipes and strings are tuned; drums and bells are struck.

translations.literal: Dancing the image of virtue; singing the praise of merit.
translations.idiomatic: They dance the image of virtue and sing the praise of achievement.

translations.literal: The spirits all rejoice, ah!
translations.idiomatic: The spirits all rejoice!

translations.literal: Solemn solemn in their places; those who come are harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn in their places; those who arrive are harmonious.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn the Son of Heaven; the feudal lords assist him.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn stands the Son of Heaven; the feudal lords assist him.

translations.literal: Ritual has its forms; music has its standards.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual has its proper forms; music has its fixed standards.

translations.literal: Above: Ancestral temple feast songs to the spirits, two pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Two ancestral temple songs for feasting the spirits.

sentences.zh: 晉江左宗廟歌十三篇，曹毗造十一首，王珣造二首

translations.literal: Jin Eastern Jin Ancestral Temple Songs, thirteen pieces—Cao Pi composed eleven, Wang Xun composed two.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Eastern Jin Ancestral Temple Songs—eleven by Cao Pi, two by Wang Xun.

sentences.zh: 歌高祖宣皇帝 曹毗造

translations.literal: Song for the High Ancestor, Emperor Xuan; composed by Cao Pi.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the High Ancestor, Emperor Xuan; composed by Cao Pi.

translations.literal: How glorious the High Ancestor—virtue harmonized with the spirit tally.
translations.idiomatic: How glorious the High Ancestor—his virtue matched Heaven's signs.

translations.literal: Responding to the mandate, dispelling disorder; rectifying and ordering the great thoroughfare.
translations.idiomatic: He answered the mandate, quelled disorder, and set the great road in order.

translations.literal: Merit reaching the cosmos; transforming influence moving the eight regions.
translations.idiomatic: His merit reached the cosmos; his transforming power stirred the eight directions.

translations.literal: Solemn with penal statutes; molding with the dark pearl.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn in law, he molded the people like clay with the dark pearl of the Way.

translations.literal: Spirit stones spewed auspicious signs; numinous mushrooms spread of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit stones yielded omens; numinous mushrooms sprang up on their own.

translations.literal: Founding the foundation on Heaven's mandate; the Way equal to Tang and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: He founded his throne on Heaven's mandate; his Way rivaled Tang and Yu.

translations.literal: Song for the Heir-Emperor, Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Heir-Emperor, Emperor Jing.

translations.literal: Emperor Jing received the mandate, continuing the grand flood-tide succession.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing received the mandate and continued the great imperial line.

translations.literal: The imperial axis again upheld; Heaven's radiance again raised.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial axis was raised anew; Heaven's radiance shone again.

translations.literal: Foolish those two bandits—harassing our Yang and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Foolish were those two rebels, troubling our Yang and Chu.

translations.literal: Then he arrayed the chief army to grease the Qi axes.
translations.idiomatic: He marshaled the main army and whetted the axe for battle.

translations.literal: Unceasing divine strategy; illustrious royal host.
translations.idiomatic: Unceasing was his divine strategy; glorious his royal host.

translations.literal: Whale and minnow already pacified; merit foremost within the imperial realm.
translations.idiomatic: The great and small foes were subdued; his merit topped the realm.

translations.literal: Song for the Great Ancestor, Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Great Ancestor, Emperor Wen.

translations.literal: Great Ancestor equal to the sage; royal design newly harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Ancestor matched the sage; his royal design newly harmonized all.

translations.literal: Benevolent teaching filling the four frontiers; Heaven's foundation repeatedly elevated.
translations.idiomatic: His benevolent teaching filled the four borders; Heaven's foundation rose ever higher.

translations.literal: The imperial house had many calamities; sternly purifying the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial house knew many trials; he sternly cleansed the Purple Palace.

translations.literal: Awe fierce as autumn frost; favor surpassing spring wind.
translations.idiomatic: His awe was sharp as autumn frost; his grace warmer than spring wind.

translations.literal: Pacifying Shu, subduing Chu—by civil arts and by martial prowess.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified Shu and subdued Chu, by culture and by arms alike.

translations.literal: Suddenly possessing the Shen region; renown flowing without end.
translations.idiomatic: He came to hold the heartland; his fame flows on without end.

translations.literal: Song for the Heir-Founder, Emperor Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Heir-Founder, Emperor Wu.

translations.literal: How solemn Emperor Wu—truly reverently executing reverence and clarity.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn Emperor Wu—truly reverent, bright, and worthy.

translations.literal: Responding to the season, ascending to spirithood; the dragon flew in the Purple Court.
translations.idiomatic: He answered the age and ascended the throne; the dragon flew in the Purple Court.

translations.literal: The hundred officials in timely order; hearing and deciding according to feeling.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred offices kept their seasons; he judged affairs with human feeling.

translations.literal: Strange realms already submitted; false Wu also pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Distant lands had already submitted; false Wu was also pacified.

translations.literal: In the morning flowed sweet dew; at night mirrored the bright star.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet dew flowed at dawn; bright stars shone at night.

translations.literal: In the fields there was pounding earth; along the roads hung songs of praise.
translations.idiomatic: In the fields men beat the clods for joy; along the roads songs of praise were heard.

translations.literal: Song for the Middle Ancestor, Emperor Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Middle Ancestor, Emperor Yuan.

translations.literal: Fortune stalled at one hundred six; Heaven's net loosened its string.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune faltered in the calamitous age; Heaven's net slackened its cord.

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan suddenly rose; his net caged the Jiang and Han.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan suddenly arose and cast his net over the Jiang and Han.

translations.literal: Looking up, matching the seven regulators; looking down, pacifying disaster and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: He matched the seven luminaries above and quelled disaster and disorder below.

translations.literal: Transforming as the wind moves; grace like rain scattering.
translations.idiomatic: His transforming power moved like the wind; his grace fell like scattered rain.

translations.literal: Sunken radiance renewed its brilliance; golden splendor again gleaming.
translations.idiomatic: Dimmed light blazed anew; golden glory shone again.

translations.literal: Virtue topping a thousand ages; luxuriant with surplus splendor.
translations.idiomatic: His virtue topped a thousand years; his glory overflowed in splendor.

translations.literal: Song for the Solemn Ancestor, Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Solemn Ancestor, Emperor Ming.

translations.literal: Bright bright Solemn Ancestor—expanding and magnifying the imperial fief.
translations.idiomatic: Bright was the Solemn Ancestor—he enlarged and exalted the imperial inheritance.

translations.literal: Heroic wind early issued; clear radiance filling the road.
translations.idiomatic: His heroic spirit rose early; clear light filled the road.

translations.literal: Treacherous rebels indulged in perversity; none followed the imperial measure.
translations.idiomatic: Traitors ran wild in perversity and would not follow the imperial rule.

translations.literal: Personally raising the vermilion banner, then opening Heaven's pace.
translations.idiomatic: He himself raised the vermilion banner and opened Heaven's path.

translations.literal: Grand design deep and vast; lofty net cloud-spread.
translations.idiomatic: His grand design was deep and vast; his lofty net spread like clouds.

translations.literal: All things at peace; the great foundation eternally firm.
translations.idiomatic: All things were at peace; the great foundation stood firm forever.

translations.literal: Song for the Manifest Ancestor, Emperor Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Manifest Ancestor, Emperor Cheng.

translations.literal: How fine the Manifest Ancestor—Way's grace mysteriously spread.
translations.idiomatic: How fine the Manifest Ancestor—his Way's grace spread in mystery.

translations.literal: Thereby proclaiming virtuous sound; distant things thereby harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed virtuous sound; distant things were thereby harmonized.

translations.literal: Transcending in virtue, treading in benevolence—none but the spirits could surpass him.
translations.idiomatic: He surpassed others in virtue and walked in benevolence—only the spirits could outdo him.

translations.literal: Spreading the pure wind; washing with clear waves.
translations.idiomatic: He spread the pure wind and washed the realm with clear waves.

translations.literal: Twin trunks reflected on the mound; crying phoenixes perched in the branches.
translations.idiomatic: Twin trunks appeared on the mound; singing phoenixes perched in the branches.

translations.literal: Same measure as Fangxun; righteousness covering mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He matched Fangxun in measure; his righteousness covered mountains and rivers.

translations.literal: Song for Emperor Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to Emperor Kang.

translations.literal: Emperor Kang solemn and solemn, looking up to inherit the great virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn was Emperor Kang, who looked up to inherit the great virtue.

translations.literal: Acting yet not dominating; refined sound filling the four borders.
translations.idiomatic: He acted yet did not dominate; refined music filled the four borders.

translations.literal: Restraining evil with sincerity; calming things with silence.
translations.idiomatic: He restrained evil through sincerity and stilled the realm through silence.

translations.literal: Awe quieting the realm; the Way proclaimed in the states.
translations.idiomatic: His awe quieted the realm; his Way was proclaimed throughout the land.

translations.literal: Song for the Filial Ancestor, Emperor Mu.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Filial Ancestor, Emperor Mu.

translations.literal: Emperor Xiao early wise; good sound truly excellent.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiao was wise from youth; his excellent renown was truly fine.

translations.literal: Like that morning star—brilliant radiance at Fusang.
translations.idiomatic: Like the morning star—his bright radiance rose at Fusang.

translations.literal: Hanging instructions in the splendorous canopy; flowing moisture to the eight wilds.
translations.idiomatic: He hung his teachings in the splendid canopy; his grace flowed to the eight wilds.

translations.literal: Mysteriously assisting the profound mystery; therein comprising the statutes and regulations.
translations.idiomatic: He mysteriously upheld the profound Way and thereby encompassed the statutes.

translations.literal: Westward pacified presumptuous Shu; northward quieted the old borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the west he pacified rebellious Shu; in the north he stilled the old frontiers.

translations.literal: Lofty designs reaching distant lands; at court there remained lingering fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: His lofty designs reached distant realms; at court his lingering fragrance remained.

translations.literal: Song for Emperor Ai.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to Emperor Ai.

translations.literal: How solemn Emperor Ai—sage heart empty and far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn Emperor Ai—his sage heart was empty and far-reaching.

translations.literal: Elegantly fond of the profound antiquity; the Great Hall is what he trod.
translations.idiomatic: He loved the profound antiquity and walked in the way of the Great Hall.

translations.literal: The Way esteemed non-action; governance kept to ease and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: The Way he honored was non-action; his rule rested on ease and simplicity.

translations.literal: Transforming like wind moving; the people like grass bowing down.
translations.idiomatic: His transforming power moved like the wind; the people bowed like grass.

translations.literal: Although said to have ascended far; fine repute ever more displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Though he has ascended far, his fine renown shines ever brighter.

translations.literal: Serene serene "Cloud" and "Shao"—utterly beautiful, utterly good.
translations.idiomatic: Serene are the "Cloud" and "Shao"—utterly beautiful, utterly good.

sentences.zh: 歌太宗簡文皇帝 王珣造

translations.literal: Song for the Great Ancestor, Emperor Jianwen; composed by Wang Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Great Ancestor, Emperor Jianwen; composed by Wang Xun.

translations.literal: Imperial is Jianwen—manifest, manifest in Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: Imperial is Jianwen—how manifest in Heaven!

translations.literal: Spirit-bright as a god; all-pervading and tranquil as an abyss.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit-bright as a god; all-encompassing and still as an abyss.

translations.literal: Empty responsiveness when it comes; substance along with its transformations.
translations.idiomatic: Empty in response when it comes; substance moves with every change.

translations.literal: Gentle gentle heart-transformation; daily use without speech.
translations.idiomatic: Gently he transformed hearts; in daily use he needed no words.

translations.literal: Easy yet having intimacy; simple yet able to be handed down.
translations.idiomatic: Easy, yet intimate; simple, yet fit to be handed down.

translations.literal: Observing the flow, ever farther; seeking the root, ever more abstruse.
translations.idiomatic: Watch the stream and it runs ever farther; seek the source and it grows ever deeper.

sentences.zh: 歌烈宗孝武皇帝 王珣造

translations.literal: Song for the Manifest Ancestor, Emperor Xiaowu; composed by Wang Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to the Manifest Ancestor, Emperor Xiaowu; composed by Wang Xun.

translations.literal: Heaven's mirror upon Jin—reverent, ah, Manifest Ancestor!
translations.idiomatic: Heaven looks upon Jin—reverent, ah, Manifest Ancestor!

translations.literal: Same standard as Cultured Ancestor; dark silence truly granted.
translations.idiomatic: He matched the Cultured Ancestor's measure; in still depth Heaven's grace was granted.

translations.literal: Awesome yet not fierce; constrained yet able to penetrate.
translations.idiomatic: He awed without fierceness; restrained, yet he reached through to all.

translations.literal: Divine bell-cymbal one shake; nine regions come together.
translations.idiomatic: At one stroke of the sacred gong, the nine regions united as one.

translations.literal: The Way amassed at Huai and sea; "Ya" and "Song" from the east.
translations.idiomatic: His Way piled deep at Huai and the sea; the "Ya" and "Song" hymns came from the east.

translations.literal: Breath pottery pure dew; transformation harmonized season's harmony.
translations.idiomatic: His breath molded men like pure dew; his transforming power joined the age to harmony.

sentences.zh: 四時祠祀歌 曹毗造

translations.literal: Four Seasons Sacrifice Songs; composed by Cao Pi.
translations.idiomatic: Four Seasons Sacrifice Songs, composed by Cao Pi.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn pure temple; lofty lofty sage merit.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn stands the pure temple; lofty is the sage emperor's merit.

translations.literal: Myriad states come as guests; ritual and decorum have proper bearing.
translations.idiomatic: From myriad states guests arrive; ritual and decorum are properly borne.

translations.literal: Bells and drums shaken; metal and stone bright.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums resound; metal and stone ring bright.

translations.literal: Proclaiming auspicious fortune; martial opening the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaims auspicious fortune; by martial prowess he opened the foundation.

translations.literal: The spirits thus rejoice, ah!
translations.idiomatic: The spirits rejoice!

translations.literal: Ordering pipes and strings; those who come are harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Pipes and strings are tuned; all who come join in harmony.

translations.literal: Expounding merit and virtue; uttering clear songs.
translations.idiomatic: They expound merit and virtue and sing clear songs.

translations.literal: The spirits thus rejoice, ah!
translations.idiomatic: The spirits rejoice!

translations.literal: Vast vast dark transformation; moisture covering nine soils.
translations.idiomatic: Vast is the dark transforming power; its moisture covers the nine soils.

translations.literal: People none not pleased; Way none not followed.
translations.idiomatic: No people are displeased; no one fails to follow the Way.

translations.literal: Rites have forms; music has patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual has its proper forms; music has its fixed patterns.

translations.literal: Chanting nine achievements; eternally without limit.
translations.idiomatic: They chant the nine achievements, without end or limit.

translations.literal: The spirits thus rejoice, ah!
translations.idiomatic: The spirits rejoice!

sentences.zh: 宋宗廟登歌八篇 王韶之造

translations.literal: Liu Song Ancestral Temple Ascending Songs, eight pieces; composed by Wang Shaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Liu Song Ancestral Temple Ascending Songs, composed by Wang Shaozhi.

translations.literal: Continuous continuous distant line; illustrious brightness ever blending.
translations.idiomatic: Long and unbroken is the distant line; illustrious brightness ever blends.

translations.literal: Han virtue not far; Yao has lingering wind.
translations.idiomatic: Han virtue is not far off; Yao's lingering wind still blows.

translations.literal: How solemn the imperial ancestor; eternal generations abundant.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn the imperial ancestor; his line flourishes through eternal generations.

translations.literal: Root and branches only blessed; bequeathed to posterity without end.
translations.idiomatic: Root and branches alike are blessed; what he bequeathed has no end.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of Beiping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of Beiping Commandery.

translations.literal: Then establishing the pure temple; pure temple solemn solemn.
translations.idiomatic: They raise the pure temple; solemn, solemn is the pure temple.

translations.literal: Then preparing ritual bearing; ritual bearing grave grave.
translations.idiomatic: They prepare ritual bearing; grave and dignified is the ritual bearing.

translations.literal: Illustrious and true imperial ancestor; manifest is this successor's service.
translations.idiomatic: Illustrious and true is the imperial ancestor; bright is the heir who serves him.

translations.literal: Bestowing here abundant blessing; thereby cherishing many fortunes.
translations.idiomatic: He bestows abundant blessing here; thereby we cherish many fortunes.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of the Chancellor's Staff Office.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of the Chancellor's Staff Office.

translations.literal: The four counties already ordered; panpipes already raised.
translations.idiomatic: The four counties are arrayed; panpipes and flutes are raised.

translations.literal: In the hall presenting six hu; in the courtyard dancing eight plumes.
translations.idiomatic: In the hall six hu vessels are offered; in the courtyard eight plumes dance.

translations.literal: Former kings had their canon; able to sacrifice to the imperial ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Former kings left their canon; we are able to sacrifice to the imperial ancestor.

translations.literal: Greatly illustrious grand achievement; eternally granting excellent blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly illustrious is his grand achievement; may excellent blessing be granted forever.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of Kaifeng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of Kaifeng Commandery.

translations.literal: Bells and drums huang-huang; awe-inspiring bearing jiang-jiang.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums sound huang-huang; awe-inspiring is the bearing jiang-jiang.

translations.literal: Warm and reverent in ritual and music; respectfully offering to the former emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Warm and reverent in ritual and music, we respectfully offer to the former emperor.

translations.literal: Surpassing virtue hanging down benevolence; continuing the track, doubling the radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Surpassing virtue hangs down benevolence; he continues the track and doubles the radiance.

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate pure blessing; favoring us without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate brings pure blessing; it favors us without bound.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of Wuyuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of Wuyuan Commandery.

translations.literal: Shining is the imperial ancestor; the Emperor measured his heart.
translations.idiomatic: Shining is the imperial ancestor; the Emperor took the measure of his heart.

translations.literal: Forever speaking of matching the mandate; spreading this fine repute.
translations.idiomatic: Forever he matched Heaven's mandate; this fine repute spreads abroad.

translations.literal: Thinking of our abundant plans; like jade, like gold.
translations.idiomatic: We think on his abundant plans, precious as jade, precious as gold.

translations.literal: Swiftly running at the steps; this is what he inspects, this is what he delights in.
translations.idiomatic: Swiftly we run to the steps; this he inspects, this he delights in.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Lord of Dong'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Lord of Dong'an Commandery.

translations.literal: How abundant the Filial Emperor; equal to the sage, broad and deep.
translations.idiomatic: How abundant is the Filial Emperor—equal to the sage, broad and deep.

translations.literal: Sending forth auspiciousness, birthing celebration; bright blessing from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He sent forth auspicious signs and birthed celebration; bright blessing came from Heaven.

translations.literal: Virtue spread on metal and stone; Way covering pipes and strings.
translations.idiomatic: His virtue is spread on metal and stone; his Way covers pipes and strings.

translations.literal: The mandate already gathered; fine wind eternally proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The mandate is already gathered; his fine wind is proclaimed forever.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the Filial Emperor.

translations.literal: Only Heaven has the mandate; earnestly seeking the lofty sage.
translations.idiomatic: Only Heaven holds the mandate; it earnestly seeks the lofty sage.

translations.literal: Brilliant is the sage martial; upholding fortune, turning the hub.
translations.idiomatic: Brilliant is the sage martial emperor; he upholds fortune and turns the wheel of fate.

translations.literal: Merit equal to spreading earth; Way equal to the banks of the Ru.
translations.idiomatic: His merit equals Yu's spreading of earth; his Way equals the banks of the Ru.

translations.literal: Stopping weapons is called martial; warp and woof are called civil.
translations.idiomatic: To halt weapons is called martial; to weave warp and woof is called civil.

translations.literal: Bird and dragon lost their tallies; cloud and fire replaced their names.
translations.idiomatic: Bird and dragon tallies were cast aside; cloud and fire signs took their names.

translations.literal: Receiving the end, changing things; making our Song capital.
translations.idiomatic: He received the mandate's end, changed the age, and made our Song capital.

translations.literal: Ultimate Way only the king; great enterprise has its splendor.
translations.idiomatic: The ultimate Way belongs only to the king; great enterprise has its splendor.

translations.literal: Lowering virtue to the myriad people; ascending song in the pure temple.
translations.idiomatic: He lowers virtue to the myriad people; ascending songs rise in the pure temple.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for the shrine to the High Ancestor, Emperor Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for the shrine to the High Ancestor, Emperor Wu.

translations.literal: Grand grand sleeping temple; holding the scepter in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Grand stands the sleeping temple; the scepter is held in the court.

translations.literal: Pipes and flutes already arrayed; sacrificial images already full.
translations.idiomatic: Pipes and flutes are arrayed; sacrificial images stand full.

translations.literal: Millet and millet not fragrant; bright sacrifice only fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Millet and millet are not the fragrance; bright virtue alone is fragrant.

translations.literal: Music complete, rites fulfilled; pure offerings and offered pig with sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Music is complete and rites fulfilled; pure offerings and the offered pig are presented with sincerity.

translations.literal: The spirits arrive in thought; granting excellent auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits arrive in our thoughts; they grant excellent auspiciousness.

translations.literal: Numerous numerous assembled lords; eternally viewing this accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: Numerous lords are assembled; they eternally behold this accomplishment.

translations.literal: Above: Ascending song for enjoying the spirits at the seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: Above: Ascending hymn for enjoying the spirits at the seven temples.

translations.literal: 〈And together using the song chapter for the Empress Dowager.〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Together with the song chapter for the Empress Dowager.〉

sentences.zh: 世祖孝武皇帝歌 謝莊造

translations.literal: Song of Emperor Xiaowu, the Filial; composed by Xie Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn to Emperor Xiaowu, the Filial; composed by Xie Zhuang.

translations.literal: The Emperor bestowed the two ancestors; long generations many blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor bestowed the two ancestors; long generations, many blessings.

translations.literal: How solemn the sagely father; inheriting the sage, continuing the measure.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn the sagely father; he inherited the sage and continued the measure.

translations.literal: Dark pole loosened the reins; dry pivot dropped the thread.
translations.idiomatic: The dark pole loosened its reins; the pivot of Heaven dropped its thread.

translations.literal: Opening our imperial span; tying our Song house.
translations.idiomatic: He opened our imperial span and bound fast our Song house.

translations.literal: Sweeping and settling the four seas; first establishing the numinous capital.
translations.idiomatic: He swept and settled the four seas and first established the numinous capital.

translations.literal: Restoring rites, gathering music; scattering horses, dismantling walls.
translations.idiomatic: He restored rites and gathered music; war horses were scattered, walls dismantled.

translations.literal: Moisture filling the nine possessions; transformation floating the eight seas.
translations.idiomatic: His moisture fills the nine possessions; his transforming power floats the eight seas.

translations.literal: Auspicious clouds supporting the sleeve; sweet dew flying on the eaves.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious clouds support his sleeve; sweet dew flies upon the eaves.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn pure temple; manifest manifest closed palace.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the pure temple; manifest is the closed palace.

translations.literal: Dancing the image of virtue; sounding stone and chime presenting wind.
translations.idiomatic: They dance the image of virtue; stone chimes and bells present the wind.

translations.literal: Millet and millet not abundant; bright virtue only exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Millet and millet are not the offering; bright virtue alone is exalted.

translations.literal: The spirits will delight and stop; lowering blessing without end.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits will delight and descend; blessing without end they lower.

translations.literal: Song of the Empress Dowager Xuan's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Hymn for the temple of Empress Dowager Xuan.

translations.literal: Receiving auspiciousness in moon's radiance; nurturing virtue in canopy's light.
translations.idiomatic: She received auspiciousness in the moon's radiance and nurtured virtue in the canopy's light.

translations.literal: Continuing the emblem of Gui and Ru; thinking fondly of Zhou's Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: She continued the emblem of Gui and Ru and thought fondly of Zhou's Jiang.

translations.literal: Mother overseeing the myriad 㝢; instruction genial in the purple chamber.
translations.idiomatic: As mother she ruled the myriad realms; her instruction was genial in the purple chamber.

translations.literal: Red strings and jade pipes; thereby bearing jade fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Red strings and jade pipes thereby bear jade fragrance.

sentences.zh: 晉四廂樂歌三首 傅玄造

translations.literal: Jin Four-Side Hall Music Songs, three pieces; composed by Fu Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Three Jin Four-Side Hall Music Songs, composed by Fu Xuan.

translations.literal: Heaven's mirror upon Jin; generations' fortune sage emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mirror rests upon Jin; sage emperor of generations' fortune.

translations.literal: Times aligned with the seven regulators; courting here the myriad directions.
translations.idiomatic: The times align with the seven regulators; here the myriad directions pay court.

translations.literal: 〈The first〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈First section〉

translations.literal: Bells and drums thus shaken; nine guests complete in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums resound; the nine guests complete the ritual.

translations.literal: Correct position at court; grave grave numerous numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In correct position at court they stand grave and numerous.

translations.literal: 〈The second〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Second section〉

translations.literal: Brilliant brilliant three luminaries; truly attached to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Brilliant are the three luminaries; truly they cling to Heaven.

translations.literal: Lord and consort are the image; awe-inspiring bearing very reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Lord and consort are the image; awe-inspiring and very reverent is their bearing.

translations.literal: 〈The third〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Third section〉

translations.literal: Leading ritual without fault; none not advancing in virtue.
translations.idiomatic: He leads ritual without fault; none fail to advance in virtue.

translations.literal: Modeling the sage emperor; myriad states only standard.
translations.idiomatic: He models the sage emperor; to myriad states he is the only standard.

translations.literal: 〈The fourth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Fourth section〉

translations.literal: Above: "Heaven's Mirror," four chapters, four lines per chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Above: "Heaven's Mirror," four chapters of four lines each.

translations.literal: New Year's Day great assembly ceremonial song.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial song for the New Year's Day great assembly.

translations.literal: How brilliant brilliant; sage virtue dragon rising.
translations.idiomatic: How brilliant—sage virtue rises like the dragon.

translations.literal: Three mornings offering wine; myriad years is what is received.
translations.idiomatic: On three mornings wine is offered; myriad years are received.

translations.literal: Spreading blessing to the four directions; like the sun's rising.
translations.idiomatic: He spreads blessing to the four directions, like the sun's rising.

translations.literal: From Heaven descending fortune; primal auspiciousness has its sign.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune descends from Heaven; primal auspiciousness has its sign.

translations.literal: Above: "How Brilliant," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: Above: "How Brilliant," one chapter of eight lines.
