translations.literal: Longevity wine song.
translations.idiomatic: Song for the longevity wine.

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate great Jin; bearing and nurturing the multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate is great Jin, bearing and nurturing the multitudes.

translations.literal: How solemn the lofty virtue; following the time thereby transforming and forming.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn the lofty virtue; following the times, it transforms and forms.

translations.literal: 〈The first〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈First section〉

translations.literal: From the ancestor matching the mandate; imperial imperial lord and consort.
translations.idiomatic: From the ancestor he matched the mandate; imperial are lord and consort.

translations.literal: Continuing Heaven, founding enterprise; proclaiming civil achievement.
translations.idiomatic: He continued Heaven and founded enterprise; he proclaimed civil achievement.

translations.literal: 〈The second〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Second section〉

translations.literal: Greatly illustrious proclaiming civil; first knowing planting and reaping.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly illustrious in proclaiming civil ways; first he knew planting and reaping.

translations.literal: Able reverence, able frugality; sufficient teaching, sufficient food.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent and frugal he was; teaching and food were sufficient.

translations.literal: 〈The third〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Third section〉

translations.literal: Already teaching them food; broadly crossing difficult straits.
translations.idiomatic: Having taught them food, he broadly crossed difficult straits.

translations.literal: High God is what assists; lower people what is pacified.
translations.idiomatic: High God assists him; the lower people are pacified.

translations.literal: 〈The fourth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Fourth section〉

translations.literal: Heaven assists the sage emperor; myriad states come to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven aids the sage emperor; from myriad states congratulations arrive.

translations.literal: Although at ease, not at ease; qian-qian without leisure.
translations.idiomatic: Though at ease, he is not at ease; ever qian-qian, without leisure.

translations.literal: 〈The fifth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Fifth section〉

translations.literal: Then rectifying the suburban mound; then fixing the altar of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Then he rectified the suburban mound and fixed the altar of soil and grain.

translations.literal: Vast vast making the ancestor; light dwelling throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Vastly he made the ancestor; his radiance dwells throughout the realm.

translations.literal: 〈The sixth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Sixth section〉

translations.literal: Only reverent morning offerings; therein performing the food-raising.
translations.idiomatic: Only reverent are the morning offerings; therein the food-raising is performed.

translations.literal: Exhausting ritual, supplying the imperial; fine music has its order.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual is exhausted and the imperial table supplied; fine music keeps its order.

translations.literal: 〈The seventh〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Seventh section〉

translations.literal: Feather-trees set up, frames established; sheng and yong thereby interspersed.
translations.idiomatic: Feather-trees are set up and frames established; sheng and yong are interspersed.

translations.literal: Zithers and se aligned in rows; also there are chi and xun.
translations.idiomatic: Zithers and se are aligned in rows; there are also chi and xun.

translations.literal: 〈The eighth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Eighth section〉

translations.literal: Huang-huang drums and bells; qiang-qiang chimes and pipes.
translations.idiomatic: Huang-huang sound the drums and bells; qiang-qiang the chimes and pipes.

translations.literal: Eight sounds able to harmonize; thereby level, thereby simple.
translations.idiomatic: The eight sounds harmonize; thereby level, thereby simple.

translations.literal: 〈The ninth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Ninth section〉

translations.literal: Already level, already simple; its greatness cannot be defended against.
translations.idiomatic: Already level and simple; its greatness cannot be defended against.

translations.literal: Wind transformation secretly rising; like clouds, like rain.
translations.idiomatic: Wind transformation secretly rises, like clouds, like rain.

translations.literal: 〈The tenth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Tenth section〉

translations.literal: Like clouds covering; like rain moistening.
translations.idiomatic: Like clouds that cover; like rain that moistens.

translations.literal: Sound teaching what is reached; none not thinking compliant.
translations.idiomatic: Where sound teaching reaches, none fail to think compliant thoughts.

translations.literal: 〈The eleventh〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Eleventh section〉

translations.literal: Teaching thereby transforming; music thereby harmonizing.
translations.idiomatic: By teaching he transforms; by music he harmonizes.

translations.literal: Harmonizing then nurturing; the season only yong-xi.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonizing, then nurturing; the season is only yong-xi.

translations.literal: 〈The twelfth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Twelfth section〉

translations.literal: Rites careful in their forms; music restraining its sounds.
translations.idiomatic: Rites are careful in their forms; music restrains its sounds.

translations.literal: How shining the imperial Yao; already harmonious and level.
translations.idiomatic: How shining is the imperial Yao; already harmonious and level.

translations.literal: 〈The thirteenth〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Thirteenth section〉

translations.literal: Above: "Heaven's Mandate," thirteen chapters, four lines per chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Above: "Heaven's Mandate," thirteen chapters of four lines each.

translations.literal: Food-raising eastern and western side songs.
translations.idiomatic: Songs for the food-raising at the eastern and western sides.

sentences.zh: 晉《正德》《大豫》二舞歌二篇 傅玄造

translations.literal: Jin "Correct Virtue" and "Great Yu" two dance songs, two pieces; composed by Fu Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Two Jin dance songs, "Correct Virtue" and "Great Yu," composed by Fu Xuan.

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate has Jin; light crossing the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate rests on Jin; its light crosses the myriad states.

translations.literal: How solemn the sage emperor; civil and martial only standard.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn the sage emperor; civil and martial arts are his only standard.

translations.literal: In Heaven thus correct; on earth completing virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In Heaven he is thus correct; on earth he completes virtue.

translations.literal: Bearing government and punishments; bearing exalting ritual and teaching.
translations.idiomatic: He bears government and punishments; he bears exalting ritual and teaching.

translations.literal: I spread the dark transformation; reaching to the central Way.
translations.idiomatic: I spread the dark transformation and reach to the central Way.

translations.literal: Above: "Correct Virtue Dance Song."
translations.idiomatic: Above: the "Correct Virtue" dance song.

translations.literal: How shining imperial Jin; matching Heaven, receiving the mandate.
translations.idiomatic: How shining is imperial Jin, matching Heaven and receiving the mandate.

translations.literal: Glorious emperor's radiance; generations' virtue only sage.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious is the emperor's radiance; generations' virtue is only sage.

translations.literal: Fine music "Great Yu"; protecting and assisting the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: Fine music is "Great Yu," protecting and assisting the myriad people.

translations.literal: Abyss, ah, not exhausted; empty yet using it.
translations.idiomatic: Deep as an abyss, never exhausted; empty, yet put to use.

translations.literal: Before Heaven not going against; reverently serving Heaven's seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Before Heaven he does not go against it; reverently he serves Heaven's seasons.

translations.literal: Above: "Great Yu Dance Song."
translations.idiomatic: Above: the "Great Yu" dance song.

sentences.zh: 晉四廂樂歌十七篇 荀勖造

translations.literal: Jin Four-Side Hall Music Songs, seventeen pieces; composed by Xun Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Jin Four-Side Hall Music Songs, composed by Xun Xu.

translations.literal: New Year's Day great assembly ceremonial songs, four pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Four ceremonial songs for the New Year's Day great assembly.

translations.literal: How imperial the primal lord; the multitudes thereby begin.
translations.idiomatic: How imperial is the primal lord; the multitudes thereby begin.

translations.literal: Treading the beginning, great enjoying; reverently receiving abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Treading the year's beginning in great enjoyment, he reverently receives abundant blessing.

translations.literal: Freely viewing the assembled lords; therein reaching the ministers and scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Freely he views the assembled lords and reaches even the ministers and scholars.

translations.literal: Reverently compliant then primal; truly also the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently compliant, then primal—truly also the Son of Heaven.

translations.literal: "How Imperial," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "How Imperial," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "How Brilliant"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "How Brilliant"〉

translations.literal: Bright bright Son of Heaven; overlooking below, there is splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, bright is the Son of Heaven; overlooking below, there is splendor.

translations.literal: Four borders dwelling heart; favor soaking the wild mo.
translations.idiomatic: The four borders dwell in his heart; his favor soaks the wild mo.

translations.literal: Softening the far, able the near; very good, not going against.
translations.idiomatic: He softens the far and is able toward the near; very good, he does not go against.

translations.literal: Coming to arrive numerous numerous; states and houses are thus.
translations.idiomatic: They come to arrive numerous; states and houses are thus.

translations.literal: "Bright Bright," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Bright Bright," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Lofty Lofty"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Lofty Lofty"〉

translations.literal: Light light states and kingdoms; Heaven sincere its blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Light, light are states and kingdoms; Heaven is sincere in its blessing.

translations.literal: Greatly illustrious wise mandate; turning to nurture the three ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly illustrious is the wise mandate; it turns to nurture the three ancestors.

translations.literal: Generations' virtue making the quest; suddenly possessing the nine soils.
translations.idiomatic: Generations' virtue makes the quest; suddenly possessing the nine soils.

translations.literal: Thinking of our imperial measure; constant norms thereby ordered.
translations.idiomatic: We think on our imperial measure; constant norms are thereby ordered.

translations.literal: "States and Kingdoms," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "States and Kingdoms," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Vast Vast"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Vast Vast"〉

translations.literal: Only ancestor, only clan; lofty bright gathering splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Only ancestor, only clan—lofty, bright, gathering splendor.

translations.literal: Answering the surpassing in Heaven; grand favor here.
translations.idiomatic: Answering the surpassing in Heaven; grand favor is here.

translations.literal: Thereby seeking its accomplishment; our emperor exalts it.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby we seek its accomplishment; our emperor exalts it.

translations.literal: Pattern solidifying its reason; going reverently, using governance.
translations.idiomatic: The pattern solidifies its reason; going reverently, using governance.

translations.literal: "Ancestors," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Ancestors," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Deer Cry"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Deer Cry"〉

sentences.zh: 正旦大會王公上壽酒歌一篇

translations.literal: New Year's Day great assembly kings and dukes longevity wine song, one piece.
translations.idiomatic: One longevity wine song for kings and dukes at the New Year's Day great assembly.

translations.literal: Treading the primal day; extending manifest blending.
translations.idiomatic: Treading the primal day, extending manifest blending.

translations.literal: Presenting feather goblets; praying for the command's end.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting feather goblets, praying for the command's end.

sentences.zh: 我皇壽而隆，我皇茂而嵩。

translations.literal: Our emperor long and lofty; our emperor abundant and grand.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor is long-lived and lofty; our emperor is abundant and grand.

sentences.zh: 本枝奮百世，休祚鐘聖躬。

translations.literal: Root and branches striving a hundred generations; excellent fortune bell on the sage person.
translations.idiomatic: Root and branches strive for a hundred generations; excellent fortune rings on the sage person.

translations.literal: "Treading the Primal Day," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Treading the Primal Day," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Goblet Proceeding"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Goblet Proceeding"〉

sentences.zh: 食舉樂東西廂歌十二篇

translations.literal: Food-raising music eastern and western side songs, twelve pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve food-raising music songs for the eastern and western sides.

translations.literal: Brilliant brilliant seven flames; heavy brightness crossing and flowing.
translations.idiomatic: Brilliant are the seven flames; heavy brightness crosses and flows.

translations.literal: We have fine guests; this is the response, this is the grant.
translations.idiomatic: Fine guests we have; such is the response, such is Heaven's grant.

translations.literal: State governance already mapped; connecting with the great enjoying.
translations.idiomatic: State governance is already mapped; connecting with the great enjoying.

translations.literal: People's liking of us; pattern following virtue and yielding.
translations.idiomatic: People like us; we pattern ourselves on virtue and yielding.

translations.literal: "Brilliant Brilliant," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Brilliant Brilliant," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: Matching "Deer Cry"
translations.idiomatic: To be sung to "Deer Cry"

translations.literal: Guest at the first mat; harmonious harmonious, numerous numerous.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest sits at the first mat, all gather in harmony, rank upon rank.

translations.literal: Having had audience, then banquet; thereby harmonizing the hundred rites.
translations.idiomatic: After the morning audience comes the banquet, harmonizing every rite.

translations.literal: Distributed by rank order; some in the court, some on the steps.
translations.idiomatic: Seats are assigned by rank—some in the hall, some on the steps.

translations.literal: Ascending to receive the platform elders; there are also brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Elders are welcomed to their seats, and brothers among them as well.

translations.literal: Assistants accompany the staff; model this standard pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants stand by their officers, taking this measure as their model.

translations.literal: Observing nourishment and rectifying; descending blessings very together.
translations.idiomatic: They observe what nourishes and what rectifies; blessings descend in full measure.

translations.literal: "Guest at First Banquet," one chapter, twelve lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Guest at First Banquet," one chapter of twelve lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "How Majestic"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "How Majestic"〉

translations.literal: Formerly our three sovereigns; great enterprise was what they upheld.
translations.idiomatic: Of old our three sovereigns upheld the great enterprise.

translations.literal: Now our sage emperor; brilliant shining, former radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Now our sage emperor outshines the glory of those who came before.

translations.literal: Flourishing flourishing, layered rules; bright illuminating the nine borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: Layer upon layer of shining rule illuminates the nine borderlands.

translations.literal: Thinking to gather and employ brilliance; the times have nothing against.
translations.idiomatic: He gathers talent and puts it to use; in his time nothing goes awry.

translations.literal: Ascending Yu's traces; none do not come in awe.
translations.idiomatic: He follows in Yu's footsteps; all come to pay him homage.

translations.literal: Heaven spreading manifest fortune; blessings treading, this is pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven spreads forth its bright blessings; fortune and peace attend his steps.

translations.literal: "Three Sovereigns," one chapter, twelve lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Three Sovereigns," one chapter of twelve lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Bright Bright"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Bright Bright"〉

translations.literal: Splendid is the Grand Ancestor; able to broaden bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid is the Grand Ancestor, who broadened bright virtue.

translations.literal: Broadly opening 㝢宙; rectifying the age, establishing norms.
translations.idiomatic: He opened wide the universe and set the norms that rectified the age.

translations.literal: Transformations not following constant paths; the people without flaw or evil.
translations.idiomatic: Change flowed without rigid rule, and the people bore no stain of evil.

translations.literal: Creating enterprise, handing down the succession; omen of our Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the enterprise and bequeathed the succession—the omen of our Jin.

translations.literal: "Splendid," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Splendid," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Splendid Splendid"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Splendid Splendid"〉

translations.literal: Fierce-cultured father-ancestor; the time was Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Our fierce-cultured father-ancestor reigned in the time of Emperor Jing.

translations.literal: Leveling danger and peril, pacifying disorder; awe-inspiring yet not fierce.
translations.idiomatic: Through calm and storm he pacified disorder—awe-inspiring, never harsh.

translations.literal: Steering the balance without straying; the imperial path brilliant and shining.
translations.idiomatic: He held the scales without losing his way; the imperial path blazed bright.

translations.literal: The seven virtues all proclaimed; its peace only eternal.
translations.idiomatic: All seven virtues were proclaimed, and peace was made to endure.

translations.literal: "Fierce Culture," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Fierce Culture," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Court Banquet"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Court Banquet"〉

translations.literal: Ah! How grand! How abundant! The former emperor, sage and cultured.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, how grand—our former emperor, sage in word and deed!

translations.literal: Patterning Heaven, making trust; great indeed as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: He patterned himself on Heaven and won all hearts—how great a ruler!

translations.literal: Carefully manifesting the five canons; the emperor's burden was diligence.
translations.idiomatic: He carefully upheld the five canons, diligent in the emperor's burden.

translations.literal: Civil and martial deployed; lushly establishing fine merit.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and martial gifts he brought to bear, heaping up glorious merit.

translations.literal: Cultivating self, crossing to good governance; the people's use peaceful and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: He perfected himself and brought order; the people lived in peace and plenty.

translations.literal: Cherishing the far, illuminating the dark; dark teaching misty and pervasive.
translations.idiomatic: He embraced the distant and lit the dark; his profound teaching spread like mist.

translations.literal: Good at the age, not boasting; serving the office, sharing the division.
translations.idiomatic: He perfected the age without boasting, serving his office and sharing power.

translations.literal: Virtue broad, transformation lofty; the Way covering without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: His virtue was vast, his transformation sublime—the Way he trod knew no bound.

translations.literal: "Ah, How Grand," one chapter, sixteen lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Ah, How Grand," one chapter of sixteen lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Abundant Virtue"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Abundant Virtue"〉

translations.literal: Lofty transformation vast and wide; the emperor's mandate broadly extending.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty transformation spreads far and wide; Heaven's mandate extends without limit.

translations.literal: Ascending our Jin Way; transcending, only the sage emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends the Way of Jin—none but the sage emperor surpasses him.

translations.literal: Dragon flying, revolution changing fate; overlooking enfolding the eight wilds.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon rises and fate is renewed; he looks down on and enfolds the eight wilds.

translations.literal: Sagely wise, reverently bright; matching traces with Yu and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Sagely, wise, and reverently bright—his footsteps match those of Yu and Tang.

translations.literal: Establishing fiefs, his blessings; swift issuing his auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: He grants fiefs and spreads his blessings; auspicious signs burst forth.

translations.literal: Three mornings practiced auspiciousness; in the end truly good and right.
translations.idiomatic: Three mornings of auspicious rite—and in the end all is truly well.

translations.literal: Its goodness what is it? Gathering those ten thousand directions.
translations.idiomatic: What is this goodness?—the gathering of all lands under heaven.

translations.literal: Chief marquises, ranked feudatories; the four peaks, tributary kings.
translations.idiomatic: Chief marquises and ranked lords, the four peaks' tributary kings.

translations.literal: Seasonally appearing, generationally enjoying; following this, there is constancy.
translations.idiomatic: They come at the proper season and feast each generation—such is the constant way.

translations.literal: Hosts bowing in the court; fine guests in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Hosts bow in the courtyard; honored guests fill the hall.

translations.literal: Song and Wei already arrived; Chenliu and Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Song and Wei have come, and Chenliu and Shanyang as well.

translations.literal: We have guest envoys; observing the state's brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Guest envoys have come to behold our state's splendor.

translations.literal: Presenting worthies, receiving plans; offering jade disks, presenting scepters.
translations.idiomatic: They present the worthy and offer counsel, bringing disks of jade and scepters of jade.

translations.literal: Protecting and blessing, commanding them; extending grant without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven protects and blesses, commanding and granting without end.

translations.literal: "Lofty Transformation," one chapter, twenty-eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Lofty Transformation," one chapter of twenty-eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Pacifying Ten Thousand States"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Pacifying Ten Thousand States"〉

translations.literal: Shaking egrets in flight; wild geese gradually their wings.
translations.idiomatic: Egrets rise on beating wings; wild geese spread their wings in gradual flight.

translations.literal: The capital city solemn and still; the four directions are the model.
translations.idiomatic: The capital stands solemn and still; the four quarters take it as their model.

translations.literal: None to rival—only the people; the king's net truly rectified.
translations.idiomatic: None rivals the people; the king's net is truly set in order.

translations.literal: Noble men come to court; saying they observe its utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Noble men come to court, saying they would behold its utmost.

translations.literal: "Shaking Egrets," one chapter, eight lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Shaking Egrets," one chapter of eight lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Court Court"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Court Court"〉

translations.literal: Dignified dignified great lord; the people's where-to reach.
translations.idiomatic: Dignified is the great lord, the people's place of refuge.

translations.literal: Trusting in ordering Heaven's work; favor and peace not exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: He trusts in ordering Heaven's work; favor and peace never run dry.

translations.literal: About to keep distant the unbenevolent; instructing with pure simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: He keeps the unbenevolent at bay and instructs all in pure simplicity.

translations.literal: Dark and bright have their order; outstanding men in office.
translations.idiomatic: Dark and bright each have their place; outstanding men hold office.

translations.literal: Nine kindreds already harmonious; the many states following and aligning.
translations.idiomatic: The nine kindreds are at peace; the many states follow and align.

translations.literal: Opening the origin, spreading statutes; the four seas like scales gathering.
translations.idiomatic: He opens the origin and spreads the statutes; the four seas gather like fish scales.

translations.literal: Harmonizing with the time, rectifying the succession; different paths, same arrival.
translations.idiomatic: He harmonizes with the age and rectifies the succession—different paths, one end.

translations.literal: Thick virtue bearing things; the numinous heart lofty and honored.
translations.idiomatic: Thick virtue bears all things; his numinous heart is raised on high.

translations.literal: Spreading and presenting upright words; receiving them without taboo.
translations.idiomatic: He spreads forth upright counsel and receives it without reserve.

translations.literal: Planting canonical images; instructing in categories of right.
translations.idiomatic: He plants canonical models and instructs in every category of right.

translations.literal: Above, teaching like wind; below, responding like plants.
translations.idiomatic: His teaching above is like the wind; below, the people bend like grass.

translations.literal: One man has celebration; the multitude of sprouts thereby succeed.
translations.idiomatic: When one man is blessed, the myriad living things prosper.

translations.literal: Our sovereign banquet and joy; fine reputation not falling.
translations.idiomatic: Our sovereign feasts in joy; his fine fame does not fall.

translations.literal: "Dignified," one chapter, twenty-six lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Dignified," one chapter of twenty-six lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Following Heaven"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Following Heaven"〉

translations.literal: Already banqueted, already joyous; gathering is the ten thousand states.
translations.idiomatic: The banquet is done, the joy complete—the ten thousand states gather as one.

translations.literal: Rites and ceremonies completing measure; things all have their proper form.
translations.idiomatic: Rites and ceremonies reach their measure; every thing has its proper form.

translations.literal: Bright bright court torches; resounding resounding drums and bells.
translations.idiomatic: Court torches blaze bright; drums and bells resound.

translations.literal: Pipes and chime-stones chanting virtue; ten thousand dancers imaging merit.
translations.idiomatic: Pipes and stones sing of virtue; ten thousand dancers image his merit.

translations.literal: The eight sounds able to harmonize; customs easy, transformation following.
translations.idiomatic: The eight sounds harmonize; customs grow easy and the people follow his transforming rule.

translations.literal: Its harmony like music; the multitude of things seasonally at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Such harmony as music brings; the myriad things find peace in season.

translations.literal: "Already Banqueted," one chapter, twelve lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Already Banqueted," one chapter of twelve lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Ascending Heaven's Court"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Ascending Heaven's Court"〉

translations.literal: Seasonal peace abundant; the six harmonies share dust.
translations.idiomatic: Peace reigns in season; the six harmonies share one dust.

translations.literal: 徃 our ancestors; awe quieting different neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: Our ancestors of old—by awe they quieted distant neighbors.

translations.literal: First settling Jing and Chu; then pacifying Yan and Qin.
translations.idiomatic: First they settled Jing and Chu, then pacified Yan and Qin.

translations.literal: Graceful graceful Culture Emperor; surpassing virtue flowing benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Graceful was the Culture Emperor, surpassing in virtue, flowing in benevolence.

translations.literal: Thereupon creating in the grass and dusk; responding to Qian, following the people.
translations.idiomatic: He wrought order from chaos, responding to Heaven and following the people.

translations.literal: Numinous omens announcing tally; auspicious signs enjoyed, thunder shaking.
translations.idiomatic: Numinous omens announced their tally; auspicious signs were received and thunder shook.

translations.literal: Heaven and Earth not going against; thereby harmonizing spirits and men.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth did not oppose him; spirits and men were brought into harmony.

translations.literal: Having conquered Yong and Shu; Wu and Hui became guests.
translations.idiomatic: Yong and Shu subdued, Wu and Hui came as guests.

translations.literal: Sushun leading their duties; arrow-wood shafts coming presented.
translations.idiomatic: Sushun led their offices; arrow-wood shafts were brought and presented.

translations.literal: Han and Hui presenting music; evenly harmonizing the clear balance.
translations.idiomatic: Han and Hui presented music, evenly harmonizing the clear balance.

translations.literal: Western travelers presenting mastiffs; Funan offering treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Western travelers presented mastiffs; Funan offered rare treasures.

translations.literal: Barbarian borderlands double-translating; dark teeth, patterned bodies.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians of the borderlands came through double translation—dark teeth, tattooed bodies.

translations.literal: Our emperor comforting them; bright mandate only new.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor comforted them; Heaven's bright mandate was made new.

translations.literal: "Seasonal Peace," one chapter, twenty-six lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Seasonal Peace," one chapter of twenty-six lines.

translations.literal: 〈Matching "Participating in the Two Principles"〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To be sung to "Participating in the Two Principles"〉

translations.literal: Solemn solemn fine assembly; there is hearing, no sound.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the fine assembly—heard yet scarcely a sound.

translations.literal: Clear libations already set out; baskets and stands already fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Clear libations are set out; baskets and stands are fragrant.

translations.literal: Rites full, music complete; "Xiao Shao" nine completions.
translations.idiomatic: Rites are full, music complete—the "Xiao Shao" in nine movements.

translations.literal: Harmonious joy drinking wine; merry yet not overflowing.
translations.idiomatic: In harmonious joy they drink wine—merry, yet never overflowing.

translations.literal: Leading the earth in joy and ease; states and kingdoms thereby peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: All the land rejoices; states and kingdoms find peace.

translations.literal: The king's plans truly filled; ten thousand ages without toppling.
translations.idiomatic: The king's plans are truly fulfilled; for ten thousand ages nothing shall topple.

translations.literal: "Fine Assembly," one chapter, twelve lines.
translations.idiomatic: "Fine Assembly," one chapter of twelve lines.

sentences.zh: 晉《正德》《大豫》二舞歌二篇 荀勖造

translations.literal: Jin "Correct Virtue" and "Great Yu" two dance songs, two pieces; composed by Xun Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Two Jin dance songs, "Correct Virtue" and "Great Yu," composed by Xun Xu.

translations.literal: Human patterns hanging as norms; abundant virtue has its form.
translations.idiomatic: Human culture hangs forth as norm; abundant virtue takes visible form.

translations.literal: Sound thereby relying on chanting; dance thereby imaging merit.
translations.idiomatic: Sound relies on song; dance images merit.

translations.literal: Shield-axes deployed; rhythm by pipes and bells.
translations.idiomatic: Shield and axe are brandished, paced by pipes and bells.

translations.literal: Feather-flutes like clouds gathering; assisting proclaiming fine traces.
translations.idiomatic: Feather-flutes gather like clouds, assisting to proclaim his fine traces.

translations.literal: Spreading beauty to utmost good; truly harmonizing seasonal peace.
translations.idiomatic: Beauty spread to utmost good—truly in harmony with the age.

translations.literal: Brilliant shining its patterns; light upon the ten thousand states.
translations.idiomatic: His patterns blaze bright; light falls on the ten thousand states.

translations.literal: Ten thousand states vast and wide; receiving our Jin Way.
translations.idiomatic: The ten thousand states stretch far and wide, receiving our Jin Way.

translations.literal: Matching Heaven in making offerings; primal mandate has creation.
translations.idiomatic: He matches Heaven in sacrifice; the primal mandate has its maker.

translations.literal: Above, transformation like wind; the people responding like grass.
translations.idiomatic: His transforming rule above is like the wind; the people bend like grass.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn, patterned patterned; formed in the dance traces.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and patterned, it takes form in the dance traces.

translations.literal: Civil and martial deployed on all sides; celebration flowing to the four borders.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and martial rise on every side; celebration flows to the four borders.

translations.literal: None to rival—only fierce merit; eternal generations thereby continuing.
translations.idiomatic: None rivals his fierce merit; eternal generations shall continue his line.

translations.literal: Correct Virtue dance song.
translations.idiomatic: Dance song for "Correct Virtue."

translations.literal: Yu following in movement; great indeed is the time.
translations.idiomatic: Yu moves in accord with the season—how great is this time!

translations.literal: The time advancing his benevolence; generations bearing peaceful harmony.
translations.idiomatic: The age advances his benevolence; generation after generation bears peaceful harmony.

translations.literal: Omen of our central Xia; proclaiming culture is the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: The omen of our central realm—proclaiming culture is its foundation.

translations.literal: Great enterprise only new; our emperor loftily it.
translations.idiomatic: The great enterprise is made new—our emperor raises it on high.

translations.literal: Layered light, accumulated radiance; reverently bright, cultured in thought.
translations.idiomatic: Light upon light, radiance heaped high—reverently bright, cultured in thought.

translations.literal: Reaching employment, there is completion; only Jin's auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: Put to use, it reaches completion—Jin's own auspicious blessing.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn sage emperor; receiving mandate already firm.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the sage emperor; his received mandate is already firm.

translations.literal: Categories of things all peaceful; fragrant merit like clouds spread.
translations.idiomatic: All things find peace; fragrant merit spreads like clouds.

translations.literal: Civil teaching reaching on all sides; sincere with pure simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: Civil teaching reaches everywhere, sincere in pure simplicity.

translations.literal: Dark transformation harmoniously flowing; covering it with leisure and ease.
translations.idiomatic: His profound transformation flows in harmony, covering all in leisure and ease.

translations.literal: Making music, honoring virtue; same beauty as "Shao" and "Hu."
translations.idiomatic: He makes music and honors virtue—equal in beauty to "Shao" and "Hu."

translations.literal: Dredging distant, dark and far; pattern following the king's measure.
translations.idiomatic: He reaches the dark and distant, patterning himself on the king's measure.

translations.literal: Above: "Great Yu" dance song.
translations.idiomatic: Above: "Great Yu" dance song.

sentences.zh: 晉四廂樂歌十六篇 張華造

translations.literal: Jin Four-Side Hall Music Songs, sixteen pieces; composed by Zhang Hua.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Jin Four-Side Hall Music Songs, composed by Zhang Hua.

translations.literal: Proclaiming the primal celebration; presenting the longevity goblet.
translations.idiomatic: They proclaim the primal celebration and present the longevity goblet.

sentences.zh: 后皇延遐祚，安樂撫萬方。

translations.literal: Queen and emperor extending distant fortune; peace and joy comforting the ten thousand directions.
translations.idiomatic: Queen and emperor extend distant fortune, bringing peace and joy to the ten thousand directions.

translations.literal: Above: princes and dukes longevity poem, one chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Above: one chapter of the princes' and dukes' longevity poem.

translations.literal: Bright bright above; greatly manifest its origin.
translations.idiomatic: Bright above, greatly manifest is its origin.

translations.literal: Dignified dignified three longevities; tributary queens only rest.
translations.idiomatic: Dignified are the three longevities; tributary queens find only rest.

translations.literal: The multitude of living things gradually virtuous; the six harmonies receiving the flow.
translations.idiomatic: The myriad living things grow gradually in virtue; the six harmonies receive the flow.

translations.literal: Three beginnings, primal year-mark; morning celebration like scales gathering.
translations.idiomatic: At the three beginnings and primal year-mark, morning celebration gathers like fish scales.

sentences.zh: 華夏奉職貢，八荒覲殊類。

translations.literal: Hua and Xia presenting duties and tribute; eight wilds attending, different kinds.
translations.idiomatic: Hua and Xia present duties and tribute; the eight wilds attend, each in its kind.

sentences.zh: 黻冕充廣庭，鳴玉盈朝位。

translations.literal: Embroidered caps filling the broad court; sounding jade filling morning ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered caps fill the broad court; sounding jade fills the morning ranks.

translations.literal: Numerous numerous morning ranks; saying they observe its brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Rank upon rank at morning court—they say they would behold its brilliance.

sentences.zh: 儀序既以時，禮文渙以彰。

translations.literal: Ceremony's order already by season; ritual patterns spreading to be manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony's order is already in season; ritual patterns spread forth and shine.

sentences.zh: 思皇享多祜，嘉樂永無央。

translations.literal: Thinking how the emperor enjoys much blessing; fine joy eternal without end.
translations.idiomatic: How the emperor enjoys abundant blessing—fine joy without end!

translations.literal: Nine guests in the court; presentation and praise already communicated.
translations.idiomatic: Nine guests stand in the court; presentation and praise have passed through.

translations.literal: Ascending auspicious signs, setting out offerings; thus marquises, thus dukes.
translations.idiomatic: They raise auspicious signs and set out offerings—marquises and dukes alike.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn Heaven-honored; lofty rites moving expression.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is Heaven's honored one; lofty rites stir every face.

sentences.zh: 履端承元吉，介福御萬邦。

translations.literal: Treading the beginning, receiving primal auspiciousness; great blessing governing ten thousand states.
translations.idiomatic: He treads the year's beginning and receives primal auspiciousness; great blessing governs the ten thousand states.

translations.literal: Morning offering above; below all harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: At the morning offering above, below all is harmonious.

translations.literal: Honoring many ceremonies; abundant ritual forms.
translations.idiomatic: Many ceremonies are honored; ritual forms abound.

translations.literal: Dancing abundant virtue; singing the nine merits.
translations.idiomatic: They dance abundant virtue and sing the nine merits.

translations.literal: Raising fragrant merit; spreading fine traces.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant merit is raised; fine traces are spread abroad.

translations.literal: Imperial transformation harmoniously pervading; penetrating dark and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial transformation pervades all, penetrating dark and bright.

translations.literal: Cherishing and softening the hundred spirits; gathering auspicious omens.
translations.idiomatic: He cherishes and softens the hundred spirits, gathering auspicious omens.

translations.literal: Hidden dragon leaping; carved tiger benevolent.
translations.idiomatic: The hidden dragon leaps; the carved tiger shows benevolence.

translations.literal: Regulating the phoenix bird; arriving, roaming the unicorn.
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix is regulated in its flight; the unicorn arrives and roams.

translations.literal: Withered worms flourishing; exhausted springs flowing.
translations.idiomatic: Withered worms flourish; exhausted springs flow again.

translations.literal: Fungus-herbs lush; thorn-trees soft.
translations.idiomatic: Fungus-herbs grow lush; thorn-trees grow soft.

translations.literal: Harmonious qi responding; auspicious signs increasing.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious qi responds; auspicious signs multiply.

translations.literal: Harmonizing with numinous tallies; manifesting the emperor's term.
translations.idiomatic: Numinous tallies harmonize; the emperor's destined term is made manifest.

translations.literal: Pacifying universe and space; ten thousand states harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: He pacifies the universe; the ten thousand states are at peace.

sentences.zh: 昊天成命，賚皇家，賚皇家。

translations.literal: Vast Heaven completing mandate; bestowing on the imperial house, bestowing on the imperial house.
translations.idiomatic: Vast Heaven completes the mandate—bestowing on the imperial house, bestowing on the imperial house.

sentences.zh: 世資聖哲，三後在天，啟鴻烈。

translations.literal: Generations relying on sage wisdom; three sovereigns in Heaven; opening great merit.
translations.idiomatic: Generation after generation relies on sage wisdom—the three sovereigns in Heaven open great merit.

translations.literal: Opening great merit; elevating the king's foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Great merit is opened; the king's foundation is raised on high.

translations.literal: Leading the earth in songs; joyfully bearing the time.
translations.idiomatic: All the land sings praise, joyfully bearing this age.

translations.literal: Constant patterns showing images; generation's qi manifesting its term.
translations.idiomatic: Constant patterns show their images; the age's qi marks its destined term.

translations.literal: Taishi opening the origin; dragon ascending, occupying the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In Taishi the origin was opened; the dragon ascended to the throne.

translations.literal: Four borderlands same wind; harmonizing and pacifying different kinds.
translations.idiomatic: The four borderlands share one wind; different kinds are harmonized and pacified.

translations.literal: The five beauties coming complete; fine living thereby succeeding.
translations.idiomatic: The five beauties all arrive; fine living thereby prospers.

translations.literal: Condensing the multitude of achievements; reaching great peace.
translations.idiomatic: The multitude of achievements is gathered; great peace is reached.

translations.literal: Extending abundant blessings; heirs without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant blessings are extended; heirs without end.

translations.literal: Root and branches a hundred generations; continuing the thread, not forgetting.
translations.idiomatic: Root and branches for a hundred generations—the succession is never forgotten.

translations.literal: Continuing the thread, not forgetting; rest having fierce brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The succession is never forgotten; blessings bear fierce brilliance.

translations.literal: Eternally speaking, matching mandate; only Jin's auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: Forever matching Heaven's mandate—Jin's own auspicious blessing.

translations.literal: Sage brightness governing the age; sincere imperial benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Sage and bright, he governs the age with sincere imperial benevolence.

sentences.zh: 廣大配天地，順動若陶鈞。

translations.literal: Vast and great, matching Heaven and Earth; following movement like the potter's wheel.
translations.idiomatic: Vast as Heaven and Earth, he matches them; his movement follows like the potter's wheel.

sentences.zh: 玄化參自然，至德通神明。

translations.literal: Dark transformation participating in nature; utmost virtue penetrating spirits and brightness.
translations.idiomatic: His profound transformation joins with nature; utmost virtue reaches spirits and gods.

sentences.zh: 清風暢八極，流澤被無垠。

translations.literal: Clear wind flowing through the eight extremities; flowing favor covering without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Clear wind flows through the eight extremities; flowing favor covers the boundless.

translations.literal: Ah, imperial Jin of the time; flourishing flourishing, equal in sagehood.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, imperial Jin of this age—flourishing, equal in sagehood.

translations.literal: Only Heaven descending blessing; spirits and earth-gods assuredly stabilizing.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven alone sends down blessing; spirits and earth-gods assuredly keep peace.
